key_insight: The reformulated simplified lattice Boltzmann method (SLBM) enhances numerical stability and accuracy for high Reynolds number simulations.
engineering_relevance: This method provides an efficient tool for simulating incompressible flows with improved fidelity.
method: Utilizes a generalized SLBM formulation with tunable high-order parameters.
Employs a predictor-corrector strategy with finite-difference discretization.
Achieves second order accuracy while resolving fine vortex structures on coarse grids.
evidence_signal: Linear wave analysis and validation against complex numerical examples demonstrate improved dispersion and dissipation performance.
watch_item: The potential complexity of tuning high-order parameters may pose challenges in practical implementations.
paper_title: Revisit the simplified lattice Boltzmann method: dissipation, dispersion and stability
